events.description: Student-led art, projections and performance bring the campus into BLINK. Saturday includes STINKSTOCK; Sunday features DJ IROH, Dance Flash Fusion and DJ Marble Garden.

events.title: BLINK Speakeasy at Redtree
events.venue: Redtree Art Gallery & Coffee Shop, OTR
events.address: 229 West 12th Street, Cincinnati, OH 45202; back-alley entrance
events.priceLabel: Free entry with password; purchases extra
events.description: A one-night late stop during BLINK, with special menu items. Get the entry password from the BLINK guide in the free ArtsWave app before going.

events.title: Jack O'Lantern Glow
events.time: Timed trail entry 6:00 PM–9:45 PM; closes 10:00 PM
events.description: Walk a half-mile trail of more than 6,000 illuminated carved pumpkins. This evening event needs its own ticket; daytime admission and zoo membership do not include it.

events.title: Jack O'Lantern Glow
events.time: Timed trail entry 6:00 PM–9:45 PM; closes 10:00 PM
events.description: Walk a half-mile trail of more than 6,000 illuminated carved pumpkins. This evening event needs its own ticket; daytime admission and zoo membership do not include it.

events.title: HallZOOween: opening weekend
events.priceLabel: Included with zoo admission; check source for admission price
events.description: The zoo’s daytime Halloween celebration includes trick-or-treat fun and pumpkin enrichment. Sunday’s schedule includes an elephant pumpkin smash at 2:30 PM and hippo pumpkins at 3:30 PM.

events.title: The Beach Boys with John Stamos
events.description: The rescheduled concert arrives at PNC Pavilion with John Stamos. The venue confirms a 7:30 PM start and a clear-bag policy; check its official ticket link for remaining seats.

events.title: Karyn White: The Evolution Tour
events.description: The R&B singer brings her rescheduled Evolution Tour to the intimate Ludlow Garage. Previously purchased tickets remain valid for the October 10 performance.

events.title: Duane Betts & Palmetto Motel
events.description: Southern rock, blues and guitar improvisation from Duane Betts and his band in Clifton’s underground concert room. The venue lists an all-ages show.

events.title: Robbie Fulks
events.description: An intimate, fully seated show by the singer-songwriter and acoustic musician whose work bridges alt-country, folk and bluegrass. Presented by Southgate House Revival and JBM.

events.title: Parker Barrow
events.description: The Nashville band’s blues-infused Southern rock fills the Sanctuary in Newport. Their sound pairs powerful vocals with a guitar-driven rhythm section.

events.title: Road to Emissions: Rwake, Deadbird and Grief Counseling
events.description: A Sunday heavy-music bill in the Sanctuary featuring Rwake, Deadbird and Grief Counseling. The venue lists all-ages admission and doors half an hour before the show.

events.title: Sploinky Rave: Cincinnati
events.description: An electronic dance night at Bogart’s on Short Vine. The venue and its official promoter list the Saturday event as ages 18 and over.

events.title: Here Come the Mummies
events.time: 7:00 PM listed event time; check source for set time
events.description: The costumed funk-rock band plays Bogart’s on Sunday. The official promoter lists 7 PM; confirm doors and performance timing through the ticket page before heading out.

events.title: Cincinnati Bearcats volleyball vs. Iowa State
events.description: The Bearcats host Iowa State in a Big 12 volleyball match at Fifth Third Arena. A Sunday afternoon home fixture that pairs well with an evening plan elsewhere.

events.title: Kelsey Cook
events.description: Catch Kelsey Cook’s late Saturday stand-up set at the Funny Bone in Liberty Center. The show starts at 9:15 PM, with doors at 8:15 PM.

events.title: Hocus Pocus Tribute Drag Brunch
events.description: A Halloween-themed Sunday drag brunch show at Liberty Center. The official calendar lists afternoon entertainment with doors opening ninety minutes beforehand.

events.title: HOCUS POCUS Vintage Flea
events.description: A Halloween-themed vintage and maker market with small businesses, a charm bar and live sewing. Entry becomes free for the final two hours.

events.title: Operation Pumpkin & Art Festival
events.description: Hamilton’s 15th annual pumpkin and art festival fills downtown with giant gourds, artisan and food vendors, and live entertainment. Sunday is the final day.

events.title: Operation Pumpkin & Art Festival
events.description: Hamilton’s 15th annual pumpkin and art festival fills downtown with giant gourds, artisan and food vendors, and live entertainment. Sunday is the final day.

events.title: Niederman Family Farm Fall Festival
events.address: 5110 Lesourdsville West Chester Road, Liberty Township, OH 45011
events.description: Seasonal farm activities include a corn maze, tractor rides, pumpkin picking, jumping pillow and play areas. Saturday runs into the evening; Sunday is an afternoon outing.

events.title: Niederman Family Farm Fall Festival
events.address: 5110 Lesourdsville West Chester Road, Liberty Township, OH 45011
events.description: Seasonal farm activities include a corn maze, tractor rides, pumpkin picking, jumping pillow and play areas. Saturday runs into the evening; Sunday is an afternoon outing.

events.title: Burger Farm Fall Festival
events.description: A family farm festival with hayrides, pumpkins and outdoor activities. The farm explicitly lists this October 10–11 weekend among its operating festival dates.

events.title: Ohio Renaissance Festival: Time Travelers Weekend
events.description: This weekend invites costumes from science fiction, fantasy, comics, film and television alongside the Renaissance village’s shows, crafts, food and games.

events.title: Fall on the Farm at Blooms & Berries
events.description: A seasonal farm outing at Blooms & Berries, with the organizer’s fall program operating daily through November 1. Check the ticket page for activity inclusions and date-based pricing.

events.title: Underwater Pumpkin GLOW
events.description: The aquarium’s seasonal installation adds glowing pumpkin sculptures, underwater jack-o’-lanterns and fall animal enrichment. Current displays run through November 1.

events.title: Land of Illusion: EDM Weekend and Haunted Scream Park
events.description: The haunt park combines its Saturday-night attractions with EDM Weekend. Expect a late-night outing; the event calendar lists the haunted park through 1 AM.

events.title: Haunted Village at Heritage Village Museum
events.priceLabel: $15 at gate; members and ages 2 and under free; parking fee may apply
events.description: Walk the historic village for trick-or-treating, storytelling and seasonal characters. New 2026 additions include an adventure trail, a carnival-themed haunted house and an old-school Halloween party.

events.title: HEIST: closing weekend
events.venue: Cincinnati Playhouse in the Park, Rouse Theatre
events.description: A theatrical crime caper using aerial stunts, projections and elaborate double crosses. Sunday is the final performance of this regional production.

events.title: HEIST: closing weekend
events.venue: Cincinnati Playhouse in the Park, Rouse Theatre
events.description: A theatrical crime caper using aerial stunts, projections and elaborate double crosses. Sunday is the final performance of this regional production.

events.title: TALK by Theresa Rebeck
events.venue: Cincinnati Playhouse in the Park, Rosenthal Shelterhouse Theatre
events.description: The world premiere of Cincinnati native Theresa Rebeck’s media satire follows a live news broadcast unraveling on air. Runs about 90 minutes without an intermission.

events.title: TALK by Theresa Rebeck
events.venue: Cincinnati Playhouse in the Park, Rosenthal Shelterhouse Theatre
events.description: The world premiere of Cincinnati native Theresa Rebeck’s media satire follows a live news broadcast unraveling on air. Runs about 90 minutes without an intermission.

events.title: Ohio Sauerkraut Festival
events.description: The final day of Waynesville’s annual festival brings handmade crafts, live entertainment and a wide range of kraut dishes, with food booths supporting local nonprofits.
events.sourceName: Ohio Sauerkraut Festival / Waynesville Area Chamber of Commerce

events.title: House of Cards Carnivale: final weekend
events.priceLabel: Free registration; rides extra, unlimited ride wristband $25
events.description: Factory 52’s seasonal carnival closes Sunday, with rides, games and fall entertainment across the campus. Food, drinks and ride tickets are sold separately.

events.title: House of Cards Carnivale: final weekend
events.priceLabel: Free registration; rides extra, unlimited ride wristband $25
events.description: Factory 52’s seasonal carnival closes Sunday, with rides, games and fall entertainment across the campus. Food, drinks and ride tickets are sold separately.

events.title: Yayoi Kusama: All the Eternal Love I Have for the Pumpkins
events.priceLabel: Check source; free for museum members
events.description: Mirrored walls turn polka-dotted yellow pumpkins into an immersive field of light. The installation closes October 18; exhibition tickets must be obtained online.

events.title: Nancy Rexroth: Secrets of My Power
events.description: The photographer’s first career retrospective draws on the museum’s newly formed Rexroth archive. An early chance to see the exhibition that opened October 2.

events.title: In the Interest of Time
events.priceLabel: $12; members and ages 18 and under free
events.description: Seven artists connected to Ohio, Indiana and Kentucky explore how photographs hold duration, memory and history in this newly opened FotoFocus exhibition.

events.title: Widline Cadet: Seremoni Disparisyon (Ritual [Dis]Appearance)
events.priceLabel: $12; members and ages 18 and under free
events.description: Cadet’s photography and installation examine Haitian diasporic life, family memory and belonging. The exhibition opened October 2 as part of the current fall gallery program.

events.title: Unfolding Elegance: European Fans from the Taft Collection
events.venue: Taft Museum of Art, Sinton Gallery
events.description: Nine intricately decorated 18th-century European fans emerge from conservation and storage in this focused exhibition. Sunday museum admission is free.

events.title: LEGO Jurassic World: The Exhibition
events.description: Explore more than 50 large dinosaur builds and movie scenes made from millions of LEGO bricks, with hands-on building stations. A separate exhibition ticket is required.

events.title: The First Annual Cryptid Ball
events.description: A costumed evening of music and dancing from Esoteric Brewing and the Covington Cryptid Block Party team, with a best-dressed contest and local collaborators.

events.title: Autumn Native Plant Sale: final day
events.priceLabel: Daily admission or membership required; plants extra
events.description: The final sale day offers native perennials, flowering trees and shrubs for fall planting. Stock varies; the Nature Center posts live quantities on its official page.

events.title: Gabe Kea at Go Bananas
events.description: Two Saturday stand-up shows with Gabe Kea at the longtime Montgomery comedy club. Seating is first come, first served; the club rates the material R.

events.title: Comedy Class Graduation Show
events.description: Catch the comedy class’s graduation performances at Go Bananas. This Sunday showcase is rated R, with first-come seating and doors an hour before the show.

events.title: Amber Joy Layne at The Comet
events.description: A two-show Saturday comedy booking in Northside. The early show starts at 7 PM, while the late show offers a 9:30 PM option with doors at 8:45 PM.

events.title: Comet Bluegrass All Stars
events.description: The Comet’s longstanding Sunday bluegrass session provides a neighborhood-scale live-music option. This date is explicitly listed in the venue’s current calendar.
